applies_to: convergence/pipeline/prospects.csv — Stage D scoring of a resolved executive prospect
purpose: Estimate the inputs of the published rubric (convergence/pipeline/scoring-rubric.md) as typed judgments, then compose them in code with the same weights the rubric publishes.

state_shape.note: Send only the fields each question needs (jaggedness #5). One state per prospect.

ipo_readiness.instructions: Place this company on the IPO-readiness ladder using only the supplied stage_evidence. Judge the single highest applicable rung. If two or more independent rungs are evidenced, use the higher one.
criteria: Growth-stage only: late round raised, no public-market readiness signal of any kind
Secondary or tender offer, or crossover public-market investors on the cap table
Late-stage round (Series D+ or 400M+ raised) with explicit path-to-public language
CFO or Chief Accounting Officer hired from a public company, or auditor upgraded to Big Four, within 18 months
Credible report of a confidential S-1 submission or a public S-1 on file

transaction_fit.instructions: How well does this company fit the stated mandate of at least one participating firm, as given in mandates_note? If mandates_note is absent, answer level 2 (unknown) and set mandates_missing true in the composition record.
criteria: Outside every stated mandate
Adjacent sector, plausible but unstated interest
Unknown: no mandates note supplied
Inside a stated mandate, company size is a stretch for that firm
Squarely inside a stated mandate with size inside that firm's range

path_strength.instructions: Using only path_evidence entries that include an evidence_url, place this prospect on the relationship-path ladder. Pick the strongest single path. A path with no URL is not evidence and must be ignored.
criteria: No evidenced path found
Board overlap two steps out
CFO-network or conference co-speaker overlap with a participating-firm partner
Named adviser relationship: counsel, auditor or underwriter publicly associated with the company, plus a working relationship with a participating firm
Portfolio company of a participating VC/PE, or a client/participating-firm nomination

seniority.instructions: Which of these best describes the resolved executive's current role at this company? Use the title on the person record; do not infer a promotion.

criteria.ceo: Chief Executive Officer or equivalent founder-CEO title
criteria.general_counsel_or_cao: General Counsel or Chief Accounting Officer
criteria.vp_finance_treasurer_or_ir: VP Finance, Treasurer, Controller, or Head of Investor Relations
criteria.other_or_unclear: Any other role, or the title is missing

reachability.instructions: How reachable is this person through a business channel we are permitted to use? Judge from contact_status and public speaking history only.
criteria: No business contact channel and no public speaking history
Public company leadership page or press mention only
Public speaking history at a comparable event in the last 24 months
Verified deliverable business email
Verified business email plus an assigned path owner who is willing to make the introduction

gates.note: Gate nouls must clear on the safe side. A failed gate removes the prospect from Tier A/B regardless of composite score.

stage_is_ipo_or_pre_ipo.instructions: Is this company at IPO stage or pre-IPO: publicly preparing for, reported to be preparing for, or recently through an IPO?

identity_resolved.instructions: Does the supplied evidence establish that this exact person currently holds this exact role at this exact company, rather than a similarly named person or a former role?

restricted_entity.instructions: Does this prospect appear anywhere on the client restrictions list, or is this company or firm flagged as excluded?

is_vendor_or_consultant_not_executive.instructions: Is this person an outside adviser, vendor, banker or consultant to the company rather than an executive employed by it?

sector_bucket.instructions: Which sector bucket does this company belong to, using the definitions in the bucket descriptions? Do not relabel a company to fit a cap.

criteria.fintech: Payments, lending, banking software, insurance technology
criteria.healthcare_biotech: Providers, devices, diagnostics, therapeutics, healthcare software
criteria.industrial_energy: Manufacturing, logistics, defense, climate and energy
criteria.crypto: Digital-asset exchanges, custody, protocols, on-chain infrastructure
criteria.other: Anything that does not fit the buckets above

composition.formula: composite = 30*P(ipo_readiness)/max + 25*P(transaction_fit)/max + 25*P(path_strength)/max + 10*P(seniority)/max + 10*P(reachability)/max, where P(x) is the expected value sum(p*level_points) for score and sum(p*option_points) for choice
composition.normalization: Each component contributes its expected points directly (level_points are already on the rubric scale); the sum is the rubric score out of 100.
composition.sector_adjustment: Apply the sector-mix adjustment from the rubric in code after composition: 0 under target, -4 over target, -10 at hard cap (and no Tier A).
composition.weights_owner: convergence/pipeline/scoring-rubric.md — change both together or neither

routing.human_review_band: composite confidence < 0.6, or any gate noul inside 0.4-0.6, or rank abstention

known_failures.case: Company with a large late round and no readiness signal scored as pre-IPO
known_failures.fix: Level 3 requires the CFO/auditor signal or higher; the late round alone is level 3 of 5, never level 4+

known_failures.case: A path described in prose but with no evidence_url counted as evidence
known_failures.fix: Instruction now states that a path without a URL must be ignored

authoring_rules: See jev/DECISION-LAYER.md D1: one dimension per question, levels are the rubric, filtered state, literal instructions, no counting or date math, expectation for thresholds only, one shape per decision.
